input.final_summary: Identified root cause: combat_test_v1.gd expects nodes (TopBar, MetaBox, GoalBox, StakeSelector) present in combat_test.tscn but missing from combat_test_v1.tscn; README incorrectly claims identical trees. Preloads/signals match combat_root.gd. Provided rename strategy: merge script into combat_test.gd, align or retire v1 scene.

content.text:
## 1) Likely problem: scene tree vs script (`combat_test_v1.gd`)

**Root cause:** `combat_test_v1.gd` assumes the **new** HUD layout from `combat_test.tscn` (`TopBar`, `%MetaBox`, `%GoalBox`, `$StakeSelector`). **`combat_test_v1.tscn` does not define those nodes** (it uses the older `TopCenterInfo` layout instead). Loading `combat_test_v1.tscn` with this script should produce **missing node path** errors when `@onready` runs (e.g. `$TopBar`).

Evidence — script expects these paths:

```79:82:c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\combat\scripts\combat_test_v1.gd
@onready var top_bar: Control = $TopBar
@onready var meta_box: PanelContainer = %MetaBox
@onready var goal_box: PanelContainer = %GoalBox
@onready var stake_selector: Control = $StakeSelector
```

Evidence — `combat_test_v1.tscn` attaches that script but has **no** `TopBar` / `MetaBox` / `GoalBox` / `StakeSelector` (search finds zero occurrences). Instead it uses `TopCenterInfo`:

```117:158:c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\combat\combat_test_v1.tscn
[node name="TopCenterInfo" type="VBoxContainer" parent="." unique_id=1946100084]
...
[node name="BankrollLabel" type="Label" parent="TopCenterInfo" unique_id=1441860414]
...
[node name="BetRow" type="HBoxContainer" parent="TopCenterInfo" unique_id=458772786]
```

Evidence — `combat_test.tscn` **does** have the nodes the script expects:

```133:232:c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\combat\combat_test.tscn
[node name="TopBar" type="Control" parent="." unique_id=1946100084]
...
[node name="MetaBox" type="PanelContainer" parent="TopBar" unique_id=1292551424]
unique_name_in_owner = true
...
[node name="GoalBox" type="PanelContainer" parent="TopBar" unique_id=131385751]
unique_name_in_owner = true
...
[node name="StakeSelector" type="HBoxContainer" parent="." unique_id=66713695]
```

Thin wrapper — default entry correctly uses the scene that matches the script:

```1:3:c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\combat\scripts\combat_test.gd
## Default combat test entry — numeric HUD (v1).
## Implementation lives in `combat_test_v1.gd`. See `README_COMBAT_TEST_VERSIONS.md`.
extends "res://combat/scripts/combat_test_v1.gd"
```

**Docs contradiction:** README says both scenes share the same tree; files say otherwise:

```12:12:c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\combat\README_COMBAT_TEST_VERSIONS.md
`combat_test.tscn` and `combat_test_v1.tscn` share the same node tree and behavior; only the script path on the root differs.
```

**Other checks (no breakage found here):**

- **Syntax / `extends` / `preload`:** `combat_test_v1.gd` preloads `res://combat/scripts/combat_root.gd` and `item_def.gd`; those paths exist under `AXEL/axel_project/combat/scripts/`.
- **Signals:** `combat_root.gd` declares `spin_started`, `readouts_progressed`, `spin_finished`, `premium_meter_changed`, `meter_full_transition_started` — matches connections in `combat_test_v1.gd`.
- **`class_name`:** none on these scripts; no conflict from that.

Optional secondary concern (runtime-only, not editor parse errors): `DEBUG_LOG_PATH := "res://../../logs/debug/debug-1d1bdd.log"` may be unreliable outside the editor / strict `res://` rules; `_debug_log` fails closed if open fails.

---

## 2) Exact files + concise evidence

| File | Issue |
|------|--------|
| `c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\combat\scripts\combat_test_v1.gd` | Requires `$TopBar`, `%MetaBox`, `%GoalBox`, `$StakeSelector` (see snippet above). |
| `c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\combat\combat_test_v1.tscn` | Uses same script but **no** those nodes; legacy `TopCenterInfo` HUD — incompatible with current script. |
| `c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\combat\combat_test.tscn` | Matches script HUD; paired with `combat_test.gd` → extends v1 implementation — consistent. |
| `c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\combat\README_COMBAT_TEST_VERSIONS.md` | Claims identical trees; **false** vs actual `.tscn` contents. |

---

## 3) Fix strategy: fold “v1” into `combat_test` and keep links valid

**Goal:** One canonical implementation file named like `combat_test`, scenes stay valid.

1. **Move implementation:** Copy the full contents of `combat_test_v1.gd` into `combat_test.gd`, replacing the single `extends "..."` line with `extends Control` (and keep the same preloads/body). Update header comments that still say “lives in combat_test_v1.gd”.
2. **Backward compatibility (optional):** Turn `combat_test_v1.gd` into a one-line shim: `extends "res://combat/scripts/combat_test.gd"` so any old scene or preload pointing at `combat_test_v1.gd` still loads — **only if** you still reference that path anywhere.
3. **Fix the broken backup scene:** Either  
   - **Replace** `combat_test_v1.tscn` with the same node tree as `combat_test.tscn` (diff only: root script `combat_test_v1.gd` if you keep the shim, or `combat_test.gd` if you drop v1 script entirely), **or**  
   - **Remove** `combat_test_v1.tscn` if you do not need a duplicate scene.
4. **project/editor:** Search for `combat_test_v1` in scenes and docs; update README so it states **either** matching trees **or** that `combat_test_v1.tscn` is deprecated until synced.
5. **UID/script refs:** After renaming scripts, reopen scenes in Godot once so `ExtResource` UIDs refresh if your editor tracks them (`combat_test.tscn` already uses `uid://dpb8qwgd5xo7d` on `combat_test.gd`).

Net effect: **`combat_test.tscn` → `combat_test.gd`** holds everything; **`combat_test_v1.tscn`** either matches that tree or goes away; optional **`combat_test_v1.gd` shim** avoids breaking stray references during transition.
